newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mostly stable.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mostly stable.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed in trading dominated by banks and tobacco.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index climbed a wafer-thin 0.06 percent to 18,405.47 on volume of 11.5 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index dipped 0.06 percent to 1,206.24 on below average volume of 1.6 billion pesos.
Profit taking in Banco Ganadero offset gains by Compania Colombiana de Tabaco, Coltabaco, on the Bogota market, traders said.
A million-share pocket-to-pocket cross deal in chocolate maker Compania Nacional de Chocolates worth more than 10.1 billion pesos swelled volumes in the Medellin market, dealers said.
Coltabaco closed ahead 2.5 percent to 4,100 in Bogota, and climbed 1.35 percent to 4,100 in Medellin.
Investors were willing to pay more for the tobacco maker, which had not had a significant offering in days, brokers said.
Banco Ganadero slipped back 1.7 perdent to 400 pesos in both Bogota and Medellin.
